newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland offers PLN 400 mln T-bills on April 16.
newsitem.headline: Poland offers PLN 400 mln T-bills on April 16.

text.p: The Polish treasury said on Monday it would offer 400 million zlotys of T-bills at an extra primary tender on Wednesday, April 16.
It will offer 300 million zlotys of 52-week T-bills, maturing on April 17, 1998 and 100 million zlotys of 26-week T-bills, due on October 17, 1997.
The value date for the extra tender is Friday, April 18.

The ministry said it would decide next Monday's T-bill offer after the Wednesday auction. In its preliminary April primary auction calendar it planned to offer 1.3 billion zlotys worth of T-bills on April 21.
